comparison.objective: Flatten a curled site plan within a table outline using steel weights at both ends.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-sheet unrolling, positioning, and weighted restraint.
comparison.success_condition: Plan lies flat and centered on the grey outline, both ends weighted, then released; numeric flatness and alignment thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable-sheet flattening and restraint, not rigid impact fracture or loose metal fragment containment. No spec versions were provided.
